title: Fact
description: A claim about one attribute of a vehicle at a point in time. Append-only with supersession: a correction is a NEW Fact carrying `supersedes`, never an edit. The superseded Fact stays retrievable with is_active=false.

fact_key.description: Open vocabulary; these are the keys the reference implementation uses today.

is_active.description: false when superseded by a newer Fact for the same key. Supersession never deletes.

conflicts_with.description: Fact ids asserting an incompatible value for the same key. Conflicts are surfaced, never resolved by last-write-wins or highest-confidence-wins.

anomalies.description: Machine-detected signals attached to this claim. An anomaly routes the claim to review; it NEVER mutates the claim, and NEVER asserts fraud or legal guilt.
